_comment: Checkpoints for the Lab_Guide modules. Every expect_policy_name is validated at load against shared/scenario.json, so a renamed topic breaks the lab loudly rather than producing a mystery unmet checkpoint. The validation blocks record what was observed against a live guardrail in eu-west-1 on 2026-08-22 at CLASSIC tier — see docs/validation-log.md V-18 and V-19.
